report().details: This will account for any gains/losses since the last report and charge fees accordingly. Any profit over the fees charged will be immediately locked so there is no change in PricePerShare. Then slowly unlocked over the `maxProfitUnlockTime` each second based on the calculated `profitUnlockingRate`. In case of a loss it will first attempt to offset the loss with any remaining locked shares from the last report in order to reduce any negative impact to PPS. Will then recalculate the new time to unlock profits over and the rate based on a weighted average of any remaining time from the last report and the new amount of shares to be locked.

returns.profit: The notional amount of gain if any since the last report in terms of `asset`.

report().details: This will account for any gains/losses since the last report and charge fees accordingly. Any profit over the fees charged will be immediately locked so there is no change in PricePerShare. Then slowly unlocked over the `maxProfitUnlockTime` each second based on the calculated `profitUnlockingRate`. In case of a loss it will first attempt to offset the loss with any remaining locked shares from the last report in order to reduce any negative impact to PPS. Will then recalculate the new time to unlock profits over and the rate based on a weighted average of any remaining time from the last report and the new amount of shares to be locked.

This will callback the internal '_tend' call in the BaseStrategy with the total current amount available to the strategy to deploy. This is a permissioned function so if desired it could be used for illiquid or manipulatable strategies to compound rewards, perform maintenance or deposit/withdraw funds. report().details: This will account for any gains/losses since the last report and charge fees accordingly. Any profit over the fees charged will be immediately locked so there is no change in PricePerShare. Then slowly unlocked over the `maxProfitUnlockTime` each second based on the calculated `profitUnlockingRate`. In case of a loss it will first attempt to offset the loss with any remaining locked shares from the last report in order to reduce any negative impact to PPS. Will then recalculate the new time to unlock profits over and the rate based on a weighted average of any remaining time from the last report and the new amount of shares to be locked.

Ethereum Parity Market Making USDC Core is explicitly isLive=true in the primary app-fetched mapping and current deposit/withdraw detail page. This is a continuous managed vault, not an individual expired Term auction, matured repo redemption-only contract, deprecated curator vault or crosschain token. Underlying is 6-decimal USDC 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48; strategy shares tsvParMMCoreUSDC use 6 decimals. Deposit/mint transfer assets from msg.sender with USDC allowance to exact strategy, issuing shares to receiver. Withdraw/redeem burn owner shares; delegated caller requires existing share allowance. Receivers, owners and amounts remain caller responsibilities.

Calls target Strategy 0x795ca0456a8b91ccddb6855bd860c5560ab4267e. BaseStrategy hardcodes delegate implementation 0xBB51273D6c746910C7C06fe718f30c936170feD0 (TokenizedStrategy 3.0.2); fallback delegates there and EIP1967 slot is written for explorer discovery, not an adjustable upgrade pointer. Direct strategy methods override same selectors. No arbitrary executor, management, permit, transfer, auction order/settlement or keeper power admitted.

Deposit and redeem round down; mint and withdraw round up, and zero-result conversions revert. Accounting uses tracked totalAssets and profit-unlocked supply, not raw balance alone. Deposit/mint have no caller min shares/max assets or deadline. Three-argument withdraw defaults maxLoss=0; three-argument redeem defaults maxLoss=10000 bps (all loss permitted). Four-argument variants take caller maxLoss in basis points and may return less assets than requested when loss is permitted.

Vault has no single user maturity or guaranteed lock duration. Strategy removes completed auction offers and redeems matured repo tokens during user funding/freeing/reporting, deposits excess underlying into its constructor-bound Yearn asset vault, and withdraws that vault for liquidity. Nonmatured loans cannot be demanded back; availableWithdrawLimit is loose asset plus min(assetVault converted balance, executable maxWithdraw). Insufficient liquidity, loan defaults, Yearn limits and upstream servicing may block exits or cause loss; no delayed claim token/queue call is admitted.

Governor/keeper controls Term allocations, collateral policy, discount adapters, concentration/reserve/duration limits and deposit/strategy pauses; TokenizedStrategy management can shutdown deposits, change performance fee/profit unlock settings or use emergency paths. Source caps performanceFee at 5000 bps of report profit. Observed explorer snapshot has isShutdown=false, paused=false, performanceFee=0, asset USDC and 6 decimals, not a persistent state guarantee. Source report profit locking and report cadence affect price per share; no yield or rate promise.

liquidity.details: Available withdrawal is loose asset plus min(assetVault conversion balance, assetVault.maxWithdraw(strategy)). _freeFunds requests existing loose+additional needed from _redeemRepoTokens.
